blocks.text:
The route gradually takes you from the city to the ocean. Start in Recife and Olinda, with canals, bridges, historic districts, old churches and views of the coast from the hills. Then spend 2 days in Porto de Galinhas, where the beaches and reefs form natural pools of clear, warm water at low tide.

The final part of your trip is on Fernando de Noronha. The mainland resort coast gives way to volcanic cliffs, small bays, trails and the open Atlantic. You have a 4x4 island tour, free time and a separate day for diving.
